notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_4.md CB4-E/4.2. About 15-18k requests, 2-3 h wall. Terminal states (exit 0, one JSON line with the status key): era_fetch_complete, or not_run_deadline when the run is still incomplete at T_seal 2026-10-22T00:00Z (marker NOT_RUN_DEADLINE.json; no seal, no analysis, no refetch, cap unchanged). Refuses (exit 2) until the committed seals/h5_cb1_SEAL.json exists, for run ids h3_power/h4_seal/h5_cb1/h5_cb1_ladders/h6_weather, for any path under cb1_extract/ or cb2_extract/, for arguments differing from the declaration, and while data-dumps > 10 GB. Weather (fee_category weather or CB2 TEMP_RE title) is excluded and counted. Sports vs other uses fee_category == sports as declared; the per-cell fee_category counts are in frame_report. 429 back-off (rps halved above 1%, chunk ends after 50 429s), collector-health pause (transient, exit 0), live-collector yield. Rows capped at min(T_fetch7, T_seal) with dropped counts. Outcome fields only in outcomes_guarded.csv.gz. Resumable per frame day and per market. Net lane: q0002 (priority 60) may hold it; this job must finish before T_seal, so the coordinator should confirm the lane is free. | 2026-10-16 priority 58->61: net lane: must beat q0002 (60) at run boundaries to finish before T_seal. | Held behind q0081a_h7_release_gate: freeze-check fix 5: refusals would burn retries; gate is created once the h5 seal copy is committed and fixes 5, 8-11 land. | Freeze-check fixes: sampling refuses (exit 2) until the committed group-S amendment matches frame_report.json; requires the h5_cb1_ladders seal copy too; strict price/trade requests (a non-200 fails the market); a missing exclusion sample is a refusal. Depends on q0081f (frame) and the gate q0081g (created by the coordinator once the amendment is committed). 2026-10-17 (autopilot, h7 release re-check must-fix 1): --data-dumps-cap-gb 12.5 added (code default 10) because data-dumps is ~9.9 GB and growing ~0.95 GB/day; with the default every start would exit 75 until the job failed, missing T_seal. Operational headroom only (collector cap now 13 GB; job writes <= 0.4 GB); outputs do not depend on it.
